hints.title: Calculate Truncation Count
hints.text: Compute five percent of total length as n divided by 20.

hints.title: Sort and Slice
hints.text: Sort the array in ascending order and omit the first k and last k elements.

hints.title: Average Remaining Elements
hints.text: Sum the middle elements and divide by remaining count (0.90 times n).

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeatedly finding and removing min/max elements takes O(n * k) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting the array takes O(n log n) time and allows direct index slicing.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should compute k = n * 0.05 accurately and handle floating point division.
